- **Coverage:** Collision coverage active on loss date; policy in force 303 days at time of loss; $250 deductible applies to estimated damages of $1,626.00

- **Red Flags/Discrepancies:** None identified; clean loss history with zero prior claims, same-day reporting, and estimate line items reconcile to total

- **Suggested Next Step:** Standard handling tier; obtain statement from insured regarding turn circumstances and attempt to identify/contact other driver for liability determination
